276406015.description:
Natural Amethyst Geode Cluster Deep Purple Crystals Medium 10-15 cm
This natural amethyst geode cluster features deep purple crystals on one side and a rough, unpolished rock matrix on the other. The crystals show good clarity with a rich violet color and vary in size, displaying a layered structure transitioning from purple to clear and white at the edges. The specimen measures approximately 10-15 cm in length. It is in used but well-preserved condition with no visible damage or repairs. There are no manufacturer marks or branding, as this is a naturally occurring mineral specimen suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or as a decorative piece.
